definitions.explanation: Rain that falls during autumn, or the rainy period in autumn (typically September to October in Japan). Also refers to the autumn rain front (秋雨前線).

examples.japanese: {秋雨|あきさめ}が{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The autumn rain continues to fall.

examples.japanese: {秋雨|あきさめ}{前線|ぜんせん}の{影響|えいきょう}で{天気|てんき}が{崩|くず}れた。
examples.english: The weather worsened due to the autumn rain front.

examples.japanese: {秋雨|あきさめ}の{季節|きせつ}になると{気温|きおん}がぐっと{下|さ}がり、{冬|ふゆ}の{訪|おとず}れを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: When the autumn rain season arrives, the temperature drops noticeably and you can feel winter approaching.

notes:
WEATHER:
The {秋雨|あきさめ}{前線|ぜんせん} (autumn rain front) is a weather pattern that brings extended rain to Japan from late August through October, similar to the {梅雨|つゆ}{前線|ぜんせん} (rainy season front) in early summer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋雨|あきさめ}{前線|ぜんせん} (autumn rain front)
- {秋雨|あきさめ}の{季節|きせつ} (autumn rain season)
- {秋雨|あきさめ}が{降|ふ}る (autumn rain falls)

RELATED WORDS:
- {春雨|はるさめ}: spring rain
- {梅雨|つゆ}: rainy season (June–July)
- {時雨|しぐれ}: late autumn/early winter drizzle
